items.name: ABL Verification Standalone Application
items.overview: A Python and Tkinter attorney bar-license verification application that supports nine US states through a unified CSV-driven workflow.
items.challenge: Attorney-license verification across multiple states relied on repetitive manual effort.
contributions: Supporting Python-based scraping and data extraction
Supporting a unified graphical user interface
items.solution: State-specific results are consolidated through one CSV-driven workflow, with structured logging and automation controls for more reliable execution.
items.outcome: Reduced repetitive manual verification effort by approximately 95% while creating a more consistent multi-state verification process.
